assessment.summary: This study reports the first detection of Anopheles coluzzii in Kenya (Turkana County) through whole-genome sequencing of larval collections from 2006 to 2021 across five counties. Resistance profiling of Kenyan An. coluzzii revealed target-site pyrethroid/DDT resistance marker Vgsc L995F at 62% frequency, the Vgsc V402L + I1527T double mutant at 38%, Gste2 I114T at 67%, low frequencies (~5%) of Rdl 296 mutations, and absence of Ace-1 G280S.
